correctness.rationale: The frozen unrestricted 'without independence' is false at a=b=1, where R=2 almost surely; the corrected complete RESULT.md is at /workspace/repairs/2/RESULT.md and addresses exactly this case. In all other cases R=2,3 are both attainable, and their strictly different conditional variances prove dependence. Reversal gives the conditional mean for all feasible r and hence zero covariance, including the exception. Given orientation, independent uniform compositions have the stated projected covariance, and the centered linear and bilinear terms are pairwise uncorrelated. In the even case equal orientation weights yield a between-orientation variance (ab/(2k))²; in the odd case the two conditional means agree and the composition counts give weights proportional to a−k and b−k. The variance formulas and positive difference factorizations remain unchanged. /workspace/review_checks/check_2.py independently verified the three rational identities symbolically and checked exact word moments in six cases, including the degenerate independence case. The general proof, not the finite sample, covers every attainable count.
